correctness.rationale: Azimuthal orthogonality splits hemispherical compression of H_l⊕H_(l+1) into 2×2 blocks indexed by m=−l..l, with diagonal halves by Legendre parity and cross entries t_(l,|m|)>0; solitary modes ±(l+1) contribute exactly two 1/2 eigenvalues. Associated-Legendre Sturm–Liouville Wronskian at equator evaluates each t as the explicit normalized boundary-value quotient. Factorial double-factorial recurrence gives the two parity-chain ratios; the even chain rises toward |m|=l while the odd chain is bounded below 1/π, and the l-branch exceeds 1/sqrt(2π). Thus the unique top |m|=l block(s) give Λ_l=1/2+sqrt(2l+3)Γ(l+3/2)/[2(l+1)sqrt(π)Γ(l+1)]. Gamma recurrence yields strict degree monotonicity and limit 1/2+1/sqrt(2π); l=0 treated separately. Independent numerical hemisphere quadrature for l=0..10 confirmed the cross entries, maximal m=l and Gamma closed formula, supplementing all-degree proof.
